usedFor: AnyDB stores structured records, and “Create Record” and “Update Record” keep them current from other steps.

bestTemplate.name: “Receive Incoming Message” in Quo, then “Create Record” in AnyDB
bestTemplate.why: Each incoming message becomes a stored record, so details live in AnyDB instead of a chat.

watchOut: “Delete Record” can remove a record permanently, so keep it out of any step you have not checked.
